# PORT Lighting Systems

> > PORT Lighting Systems provides professional theatrical, architectural, and event lighting solutions including equipment rentals, sales, installation services, and design support throughout New England.

Based in New Hampshire, PORT Lighting serves theaters, casinos, corporate events, and architectural projects with cutting-edge LED fixtures, DMX control systems, GrandMA consoles, and comprehensive production services. The company is an authorized dealer for major lighting brands including ADJ and ETC, offering both rental inventory and permanent installations.

## Key Topics

- Theatrical lighting design
- LED stage fixtures
- DMX control systems
- Architectural facade lighting
- Event production services
- GrandMA lighting consoles
- Lighting installation
- Stage lighting equipment
- Entertainment lighting
- Dimmer systems
- Safety compliance & rigging
- 3D pre-visualization
- Smart lighting automation
- ETCP certification training

## Equipment Rentals & Sales

- [LED Stage Lighting Fixtures](https://www.portlighting.com/rentals/led-fixtures): LED stage lighting fixtures for rent/sale: moving, static & battery
- [Grand MA Console](https://www.portlighting.com/rentals/console/grandma-console): GrandMA3 & GrandMA2 lighting console rentals and sales
- [DMX Dimmer Packs And Dimmer Racks](https://www.portlighting.com/rentals/dimmers): DMX dimmer pack & rack rentals: Lightronics XC62, ETC Sensor 48
- [Conventional Playback & Pocket Consoles](https://www.portlighting.com/rentals/console/conventional-playback): Conventional playback & pocket console rentals: Rerun, BCI, Elation SDC12
- [Authorized Lighting Equipment Dealers](https://www.portlighting.com/port-authorized-dealers): Authorized dealer network for theatrical & architectural lighting equipment

## Architectural Lighting Services

- [Innovative Architectural Lighting for Facades](https://www.portlighting.com/architectural-lighting): Custom architectural facade lighting & color-changing systems by PORT
- [Architectural Lighting Installation Services](https://www.portlighting.com/architectural-lighting-installation): Professional architectural lighting installation for indoor/outdoor spaces

## Theatrical Lighting Design Guides

- [A Guide to Theatrical Lighting Design](https://www.portlighting.com/blog/guide-to-theatrical-lighting-design): Guide to theatrical lighting design process, fixture selection & plots
- [A Guide to Choosing the Right Lighting for Individual Event Spaces](https://www.portlighting.com/blog/choosing-the-right-lighting): Event lighting guide: venue selection, indoor/outdoor & theme considerations
- [Rigging Inspections: Ensuring Safety for Your Performance Space](https://www.portlighting.com/blog/ensuring-safety-and-compliance): Rigging inspection guide: OSHA/ANSI compliance & certified safety experts
- [Smart Lighting for Theater, Events, and Businesses](https://www.portlighting.com/blog/brilliant-smart-lighting-for-theater-events-and-businesses): Smart lighting benefits: LED automation, energy efficiency & circadian tech
